ocl:
context Alert
inv: self.acknowledged implies self.assignedTo <> null

context Location
inv: (self.device.firmware.checksum <> '') and (self.longitude >= 7 and self.longitude <= 41)

context CommunicationLink
inv: self.isSecure implies self.stream <> null

context DataStream
inv: (self.records->any(x | x.timestamp <> '') <> null) and (self.streamId <> '' and self.streamId.size() > 0)

context AlertRule
inv: self.alerts->exists(x | x.acknowledged <> false)

context SolarPanel
inv: self.wattPeak >= 26 and self.wattPeak <= 51

context ActuatorNode
inv: self.maxLoad >= 13 and self.maxLoad <= 54

context ActuatorNode
inv: self.maxLoad >= 7 and self.maxLoad <= 50

context Location
inv: (self.longitude >= 0) and (self.site.size() >= 9 implies self.site.substring(1, 9) = 'AB')

context SensorNode
inv: (self.sampleRateHz mod 5 = 0) and (self.sensorType <> '' and self.sensorType.size() > 0)

context CommunicationLink
inv: self.bandwidthKbps >= 42 and self.bandwidthKbps <= 64

context Alert
inv: ((self.acknowledged) and (self.alertId <> null)) and (self.message.toLowerCase() = 'test')

context Alert
inv: (self.acknowledged = true) and (self.acknowledged implies self.assignedTo <> null)

context Alert
inv: ((self.acknowledged) and (self.assignedTo <> null)) and (self.acknowledged = true)

context DataStream
inv: (self.records->size() = 2) and (self.records->any(x | x.timestamp <> '') <> null)

context EventLog
inv: (((self.device.firmware.checksum <> '') and (self.device.oclIsTypeOf(Device))) and (self.message.toLowerCase() = 'test')) and (not(((self.device.firmware.checksum <> '') and (self.device.oclIsTypeOf(Device))) and (self.message.toLowerCase() = 'test')))

context AlertRule
inv: ((self.ruleId <> '') and (self.alerts->forAll(v | v.acknowledged = true))) and (self.alerts->exists(v | not(v.acknowledged = true)))
meta_contradiction_ocl:
context AlertRule
inv: self.alerts->exists(v | not(v.acknowledged = true))

ocl:
context Battery
inv: (self.healthPct >= 1 and self.healthPct <= 80) and (self.healthPct < 1)

context Cluster
inv: ((self.clusterId <> '') and (self.edgeNodes->forAll(v | v.cpuCores > 5))) and (self.edgeNodes->exists(v | not(v.cpuCores > 5)))

context DataStream
inv: (self.records->exists(x | x.payload <> '')) and (not(self.records->exists(x | x.payload <> '')))

context MaintenanceTicket
inv: ((self.otaUpdate.targetDevice = self.device) and (self.status <> '' and self.status.size() > 0)) and (not((self.otaUpdate.targetDevice = self.device) and (self.status <> '' and self.status.size() > 0)))

context SensorNode
inv: ((self.metrics->collect(x | x.lastValue)->sum() >= 9) and (self.metrics->one(x | x.lastValue >= 10))) and (not((self.metrics->collect(x | x.lastValue)->sum() >= 9) and (self.metrics->one(x | x.lastValue >= 10))))

context DataStream
inv: (self.link <> null) and (not(self.link <> null))

context Gateway
inv: ((self.isPrimary = true) and (self.connectedEdges->forAll(v | v.memoryMB < 1000))) and (self.connectedEdges->exists(v | not(v.memoryMB < 1000)))

context Cluster
inv: (self.edgeNodes->select(x | x.cpuCores < 50)->size() >= 1) and (not(self.edgeNodes->select(x | x.cpuCores < 50)->size() >= 1))
